adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow now uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. In the newly added `parseRefreshTokenResponse` implementation, any failed `safeParse` results in an immediate `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")`, so callers will no longer “log and continue” on invalid Microsoft token responses. Yet the caller still does `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)`, which is effectively a dead/misleading guard because `parseRefreshTokenResponse` only returns on the success path (otherwise it throws). The diff shows no accompanying tests for this behavioral change, which is a concrete review concern but not a verifiable functional defect by itself.
